PC:
1. The learned AGP requests for some time to file an affidavit in reply to the above Writ Petition.
Acceding to her request, we place the above matter on 17th January 2024.
2. The affidavit-in-reply shall be filed on or before 10 th January 2024 and a copy of the same shall be served on the Advocate for the Petitioner.
